name: SkySend
description: End-to-end encrypted, zero-knowledge file and note sharing

paths.name: Data
paths.description: SkySend's database and any branding files you add.

paths.name: Uploads
paths.description: The encrypted files people upload. SkySend never sees what is inside them.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Web UI for sharing encrypted files and notes, published on host as 6159

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: BASE_URL
variables.description: The address you type in your browser. Share links are built from it. It starts as localhost, which only works on this device. For other devices, change `localhost` to your server IP, or use your own https address. Keep the port at 6159 unless you use a reverse proxy.
